description:
Home Sweet Home is excited to present this 1-bedroom, 1 box room 1st floor flat located in the desired area of Morningside, Edinburgh. 

The property comprises a bright open plan living room/kitchen with dining area. A spacious double bedroom with storage, a box room which can be utilised as a study and bathroom with mains shower. The utility room just off the lounge includes a washing machine and combi-boiler.

The kitchen is equipped with an integrated electric oven and hob, extractor hood and a fridge with freezer compartment. A microwave and toaster also come with the property. 

Tenants will benefit from having gas central heating throughout the property, double-glazed windows, a secure entry system and access to a communal garden to the rear of the property. 

Spring valley Terrace is in the popular area of Morningside close to the vibrant areas of Fountainbridge, Marchmont and Bruntsfield. There is a lot to offer tenants close by. Bruntsfield and the surrounding areas have great independent restaurants, shops and pubs. Fountainpark is just a few minutes drive away where you can find a cinema, restaurants and bowling alley. Also within walking distance are the Kings Theatre, Cameo Cinema and other old town attractions.

If you like the open air, the property is just a few minutes drive to the meadows, one of the city's best-loved public parks

Morningside is well connected to the rest of the city with excellent bus routes passing close by and located just a short drive from Haymarket Station. 

Sorry, this property isn’t suitable for smoking or pets.

Council tax – C, Deposit - £1200
